scope: Static foot and turn-aware car matrices; evidence-backed implementation checks, not universal correctness or commercial-performance certification.

isolated_replay.interpretation: Focused cache-cleared replay evaluates this class alone and does not replace the original full reactor outcome.

benchmark.scope: Monaco fixture only; regional data was acquired separately. Request timer includes production validation but excludes post-timer harness validation. Serialization is separately measured.

review_ledger.scope: Nine actual upstream route geometries inspected visually in rendered SVG, with street instructions, raw/snapped endpoints and source-derived OSM metadata. One OpenStreetMap basemap view provided crossing context. This is a scoped geometry check, not a legal-access or whole-dataset certificate.

cases.observation: Rendered station-area geometry and endpoint snaps inspected. Instructions follow Fairfield Street, Whitworth Street, Sackville Street, Portland Street, Charlotte Street, Fountain Street, Shudehill and Todd Street.
Rendered route makes a larger circuit via Chapel Street and New Bailey Street before the eastern-bank destination. It does not take the short direct Blackfriars crossing used by the foot sample.
Rendered foot geometry follows the station approach and pedestrian network toward Victoria. Its route and snaps differ from car; this is expected profile-specific access.

Rendered short crossing and eastern-bank approaches inspected. Current OpenStreetMap basemap at the actual exported midpoint identifies the River Irwell and Blackfriars Bridge. The current basemap is geographic context, not the dated import oracle.

Distinct snaps on source-derived opposing A57(M) ways are visible. Geometry loops through a connection between carriageways rather than jumping the roughly 11 metre separation; forward route is 689.814 metres.

Reverse geometry uses a different connection and loops, 977.532 metres. Directional asymmetry and distinct endpoint snaps are visible. OSM way tags establish opposing one-way source geometries; this is not an audit of every motorway rule.

Rendered short segment on source way29419166, Trinity Bridge, inspected. Source highway=footway/bridge=yes and returned road_class=footway with car_access=false support the pedestrian-network sample; no claim of current legal access is inferred.

Rendered geometry passes the source via node, continues along Bridge Street, then loops via Bow Street, South King Street and Deansgate instead of making the source no_right_turn. Distance328.843 metres. This is consistent with the imported restriction; the independent core turn-storage tests provide separate algorithm assurance.
Rendered55.309 metre route uses adjacent footways/crossings west of the road via node. This is a different foot network, not a controlled comparison with only car turn restrictions switched off.

limitations: Imported OSM/model limitations remain in osm-data-limitations.md.
Upstream per-edge weight path details contain Infinity/apparent U-turn charges; they are preserved but excluded from metric proof. See upstream-geometry-detail-limitations.md.
Matrix output has no per-cell geometry; separate HTTP differential smoke reports connect these requests to the matrix scalar metrics.

final_release_review.decision: Core behaviour is complete within the recorded static street-profile, fixture and regional coverage. Raw CH comparison mismatches remain retained; explicit per-case expanded-path/storage proofs explain them. No global tolerance was widened.
final_release_review.source_state: Local feature/local-matrix branch, uncommitted changes, pinned upstream base plus source input hashes. No production edits after full Maven and live JAR checks.
scope_limits: Monaco gains do not imply regional or national gains; configured CH won five of six tiny Manchester HTTP cases.
Historical HTTP diagnostics were capped; 204 fresh path proofs cover222 indexed cases,820 retained scalars and4440 aggregate flags without claiming all original outputs/paths were captured.
OSM/model/import limitations and upstream weight-detail limitations remain documented.
Dedicated CH matrix acceleration, PT/time-dependent matrices and large/national/concurrent throughput work remain deferred.
final_release_review.operational_state: Both isolated test servers stopped gracefully; application/admin ports checked closed.

production_binary_binding.scope: Current compiled matrix production classes and configured model resources exactly match the live-tested packaged JAR. Diagnostic-only test additions are outside the artifact.

G0.note: Unmodified baseline outcomes preserved; one upstream PT cache-lifecycle failure reproduced and isolated replay passed.

G1.note: 2 DTO and 62 HTTP cases plus full reactor.

G2.note: Independent synthetic, randomized, node/edge/QueryGraph and path checks; 20000 differential OD cases.

G3.note: Retained fixture/regional, live-server smoke and recorded geometry checks completed; coverage limits remain.

G4.note: Root's recorded final review accepts completed named benchmarks, runtime, checksum/CRC, live endpoint and geometry evidence within documented coverage limits.

limitations: The unmodified full baseline failed; do not replace that recorded status with the feature full-reactor PASS.
Initial regional FAIL and two OOM/incomplete replays remain preserved; the successful replay only revisits ten cells.
Equal-cost/restriction-copy and virtual-split classifications require each case's independent legal-path evidence; tolerances were not globally widened.
No existing user service/configuration, user graph cache or user-specific regional OD files were supplied.
Imported OSM/model restrictions have documented source-data limitations; algorithm agreement does not establish real-world legality.
Default Maven skips opt-in regional/benchmark classes; separate explicit runs provide their evidence.
Large dense matrices, PT, runtime custom models, headings/curbsides and dedicated CH matrices are outside this milestone.

http-benchmark-report.json.scope_note: Fresh paths are reconstructed for each unique profile/OD and linked to every flagged indexed cell. All retained original issue scalars and aggregate counts are checked; capped issue lists do not contain every repetition's path or scalar. Stable aggregate CSV checksums cannot alone exclude compensating per-cell changes in omitted records, which are not directly reverified. Original absence of time/distance/null flags establishes only the original HTTP thresholds; fresh replay checks actual full-precision path metrics.
